description: Source code implementing EFI (Extensible Firmware Interface) interactions for Zephyr OS on x86 architecture, including functions for EFI initialization, calling EFI functions, and console output handling.

methods.name: efi_get_acpi_rsdp
methods.description: Returns the ACPI RSDP pointer from EFI boot arguments.

methods.name: efi_init
methods.description: Initializes EFI boot arguments by mapping physical memory.

methods.name: efi_call
methods.description: Performs a call to an EFI function with proper context switching and stack management.

methods.name: efi_console_putchar
methods.description: Outputs a character to the EFI console, handling buffering and synchronization.

methods.name: arch_printk_char_out
methods.description: Outputs a character via EFI console if enabled.
